items.t: Nvidia brings back Jensen Huang as chief executive
items.d: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Huang less than two weeks after he quit, saying Washington judged him no security risk. Shares jumped 31% on Monday, then fell about 5% today on governance worries.

items.t: NATO warns of Russian nuclear-armed satellite threat
items.d: Allied intelligence suggests Russia could launch a nuclear-armed satellite as soon as next month. NATO chief Mark Rutte said the alliance would defend against space threats; the Kremlin dismissed the reports.

items.t: Iran vows to fight renewed US naval blockade
items.d: Tehran said it would use every available tool against the US blockade, reinstated in July. Vice-President Vance and Secretary of State Rubio met Qatar's prime minister at the White House.

items.t: Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia kills two, wounds dozens
items.d: An overnight attack hit an apartment block in the Ukrainian city, killing two people and wounding around 40, including four children, the regional governor said.

items.t: Israeli strike kills Hamas security chief in Gaza City
items.d: Israel confirmed an airstrike in western Gaza City that killed Hamas internal security head Naeem Abu Nahel and six others. A separate strike near Jabalia killed a UN aid worker.

items.t: Sheikh Hasina says she will return to Bangladesh
items.d: The ousted leader, sentenced to death in absentia, plans to fly home on 16 December. Bangladesh's foreign minister said she would be brought back "in handcuffs".

items.t: Japan pays ICC dues early ahead of US sanctions
items.d: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said Japan will pay its full 2027 contribution to the International Criminal Court before year-end, as US sanctions threaten the court's finances.

items.t: Wall Street slips after Monday's big tech rally
items.d: The S&P 500 fell about 1% and the Nasdaq 2% as chip stocks gave back gains. HPE dropped 12% on a weak forecast, and reports of higher US tariffs on China and the EU weighed.

items.t: CrowdStrike agrees $44bn deal for Zscaler
items.d: The all-stock deal, at about a 34% premium, would create a cybersecurity giant. CrowdStrike shares fell 9% while Zscaler rose 18%.

items.t: US blacklists Singapore firm over Nvidia chip diversion
items.d: Commerce added cloud firm Megaspeed to its Entity List over fears of chips reaching China. Singapore's PM Lawrence Wong said the city would not be a conduit to dodge US curbs.

items.t: US lawmakers attack Nvidia over Huang's return
items.d: Members of both parties criticised the decision and called for tougher laws on chip exports to China. Huang is due to testify publicly before senators on 3 December.

items.t: Ex-OpenAI engineer charged with bugging executive meeting room
items.d: Prosecutors say Abdulrahman Alfozan secretly recorded dozens of OpenAI meetings, many likely containing trade secrets.

items.t: Two US states sue SpaceX over Grok sexualised images
items.d: Oregon and Virginia allege Grok Imagine's "spicy mode" produced over 1.8 million sexualised images of women, and dozens of children.

items.t: Amazon to pay $7.5bn for AI startup Decart's tech
items.d: Amazon is taking over much of the real-time AI video startup, including its optimisation software and founding team, in one of its biggest AI deals.

items.t: US probes cyberattacks on oil tankers via Fortinet flaw
items.d: Investigators are examining whether Iran was behind attacks on up to 50 energy tankers through a router vulnerability; Russia is also a suspect.

items.t: AI data centres build their own gas power plants
items.d: Facing grid waits of up to a decade, developers have announced over 100 on-site gas plants in the US, raising climate concerns.

items.t: Global warming may have halted the next ice age
items.d: A Science study finds a Baffin Island ice cap began regrowing about 2,000 years ago, hinting at a coming ice age, until warming reversed it by the 1960s.

items.t: IBM quantum computer beats classical machines on hard task
items.d: IBM and University of Chicago researchers say a quantum computer finished in 15 minutes a calculation beyond the practical reach of top supercomputers.

items.t: Leukaemia can start 50 years before diagnosis
items.d: Researchers traced the first cancer-driving mutation in acute myeloid leukaemia to decades before symptoms, opening a window for earlier detection.

items.t: COP31 collapse sparks calls to reform climate talks
items.d: After the summit failed, campaigners and officials urged ending the consensus rule that lets a single country block any deal.

items.t: UK sanctions Myanmar generals after ICJ genocide ruling
items.d: Britain sanctioned five senior Myanmar military leaders after the International Court of Justice ruled Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.

items.t: Guardian: Trump made up to $15m on Nvidia shares
items.d: Trump's holdings gained as much as $15 million when Nvidia jumped on Huang's return, after the White House lobbied for his reinstatement.

items.t: Nvidia 復任黃仁勳為行政總裁
items.d: Nvidia 董事會一致決定恢復黃仁勳職務，距他辭職不足兩星期，稱美國政府認為他不構成安全風險。股價周一急升31%，今日因管治疑慮回落約5%。

items.t: 北約警告俄羅斯或發射核武衛星
items.d: 盟國情報顯示，俄羅斯最快下月可能發射載有核武的衛星。北約秘書長呂特表示，北約會防禦太空威脅；克里姆林宮否認有關報道。

items.t: 伊朗誓言以一切手段對抗美國海上封鎖
items.d: 德黑蘭表示會動用一切手段對抗美國自7月恢復的海上封鎖。美國副總統萬斯及國務卿盧比奧在白宮分別會見卡塔爾首相。

items.t: 俄軍空襲扎波羅熱 兩死數十傷
items.d: 俄軍夜間襲擊烏克蘭扎波羅熱一幢住宅大廈，州長表示兩人死亡、約40人受傷，包括四名兒童。

items.t: 以軍空襲加沙城 擊斃哈馬斯保安首長
items.d: 以色列確認空襲加沙城西部，擊斃哈馬斯內部保安首長阿布納赫勒及另外六人。另一次在賈巴利亞附近的空襲炸死一名聯合國救援人員。

items.t: 哈西娜稱將返回孟加拉
items.d: 被缺席判處死刑的孟加拉前總理哈西娜計劃12月16日回國。孟加拉外長表示，她將被「戴上手銬」押返。

items.t: 日本提早繳付國際刑事法院會費
items.d: 日本首相高市早苗表示，日本會在年底前繳付2027年全數國際刑事法院會費，以應對美國制裁對法院財政的威脅。

items.t: 美股周一急升後回落
items.d: 標普500指數跌約1%，納指跌2%，晶片股回吐升幅。HPE 因業績預測遜色急跌12%，美國考慮對中國及歐盟加徵關稅的報道亦拖累大市。

items.t: CrowdStrike 斥440億美元收購 Zscaler
items.d: 這宗全換股交易溢價約34%，將造就一間網絡安全巨企。CrowdStrike 股價跌9%，Zscaler 則升18%。

items.t: 美國將新加坡 Megaspeed 列入實體清單
items.d: 美國商務部以晶片可能流入中國為由，將雲端公司 Megaspeed 列入實體清單。新加坡總理黃循財表示，新加坡不會成為規避美國管制的渠道。

items.t: 美國議員批評 Nvidia 復任黃仁勳
items.d: 兩黨議員批評這項決定，並要求立法收緊對華晶片出口。黃仁勳將於12月3日在參議院公開作證。

items.t: 前 OpenAI 工程師被控在會議室裝竊聽器
items.d: 檢方指 Abdulrahman Alfozan 秘密錄下數十個 OpenAI 會議，當中不少可能涉及商業機密。

items.t: 美國兩州就 Grok 色情圖像起訴 SpaceX
items.d: 俄勒岡州及維珍尼亞州指控 Grok Imagine 的「辛辣模式」生成逾180萬張女性色情圖像，另有數十張涉及兒童。

items.t: Amazon 斥75億美元收購 Decart 技術
items.d: Amazon 將接手即時 AI 影片初創 Decart 大部分業務，包括優化軟件及創辦團隊，屬其最大型 AI 交易之一。

items.t: 美國調查利用 Fortinet 漏洞攻擊油輪事件
items.d: 調查人員正追查伊朗是否利用路由器漏洞攻擊多達50艘能源油輪，俄羅斯亦是懷疑對象。

items.t: AI 數據中心自建燃氣發電廠
items.d: 由於接駁電網要等上十年，美國發展商已宣布興建逾100座自用燃氣發電廠，引起氣候方面的憂慮。

items.t: 全球暖化或已阻止下一次冰河時期
items.d: 《科學》期刊研究發現，巴芬島一個冰帽約2000年前開始重新擴大，顯示冰河期將至，但至1960年代已被暖化逆轉。

items.t: IBM 量子電腦完成傳統電腦難及的運算
items.d: IBM 與芝加哥大學研究人員表示，量子電腦用15分鐘完成一項頂級超級電腦實際上難以完成的運算。

items.t: 白血病可於確診前50年已開始形成
items.d: 研究人員追溯到急性骨髓性白血病的首個致癌突變早於病徵出現數十年，為及早檢測帶來機會。

items.t: COP31 破裂 引發改革氣候峰會呼聲
items.d: 峰會未能達成協議後，環保團體及官員呼籲取消讓單一國家可否決協議的共識規則。

items.t: 英國制裁緬甸將領
items.d: 國際法院裁定緬甸對羅興亞人犯下種族滅絕罪後，英國宣布制裁五名緬甸軍方高層。

items.t: 《衞報》：特朗普持有 Nvidia 股票獲利最多1500萬美元
items.d: 白宮游說黃仁勳復職後，Nvidia 股價急升，特朗普所持股份獲利最多1500萬美元。
